title: GEORGE ELIOT COTERIE, 1886
text: [Photograph: GEORGE ELIOT COTERIE, 1886. Caption text (rotated, partially legible): Front row — [names illegible]. Back row — [names illegible]. The photograph shows a group of approximately fifteen young women posed formally, identified as members of the George Eliot Coterie at Savoy College, 1886. Additional caption text along the side reads (partially legible): Photograph taken about March, 1886, preserved by [name illegible]. Back row, left to right: [names illegible], Savoy, Texas. Front row, left to right: [names illegible], Gainesville, Texas[?].]
notes: Full-page photograph. Caption is printed sideways along the edge of the page and is largely illegible in this scan. Shows members of the George Eliot Coterie, 1886.
